cases.label: cuda_probe_short_stable
runtime_notes: Kubernetes events include a benign extender bind EOF after the pod was already assigned; the pod still completed with IADeep GPU-memory annotations.

compatibility_fixes.fix: use a reachable Go proxy during image build
compatibility_fixes.reason: the upstream Go module download path timed out from the test host

compatibility_fixes.fix: allow HTTP etcd transport for the isolated single-node K3s test etcd
compatibility_fixes.reason: the artifact assumes a preconfigured etcd certificate path that is absent in the local test substrate

compatibility_fixes.fix: set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all for the local NVIDIA CDI runtime
compatibility_fixes.reason: the local container runtime rejects uppercase ALL as a CDI device identifier

compatibility_fixes.fix: move the scheduler secure port away from the default scheduler hostNetwork port
compatibility_fixes.reason: the direct IADeep scheduler runs beside, not instead of, the production K3s scheduler

scope: Scoped same-host same-binary full-stack evidence for IADeep's Kubernetes scheduler-extender/device-plugin GPU-sharing path.  The completed pod carries IADeep GPU-memory assignment annotations and the same CUDA probe binary completed with service scale matching the native Scheduleurm-controlled Docker pair.  This is an IADeep-scoped full-stack row, not an all-SOTA superiority certificate.
